subject: Re: Orion Analytics — hosted API pricing & commit tiers
messages:
From: Patricia Gomez <patricia@orionanalytics.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API pricing for projected volume (12M tokens/mo)

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Orion is excited about Redwood's latency and the caching story. We're finalizing an internal budget for Q1 and need a clear pricing path for hosted API usage.

High-level ask: can you share a committed-tier offer (per-token) for ~12M tokens / month (steady-state) with a 12-month commit? Also interested in a three-tier structure if we want to scale to 25M/mo. We want to understand:
- committed per-token price vs your published rate card
- what discount bands are typical for these breakpoints
- minimum monthly commitment we need to qualify for a custom rate
- contractual protections (rate-card fallback if usage falls, audit clauses)

I've attached our SOW that includes the usage profile. Can you come back with a proposed path and timing for an approved exception if required? We're targeting a purchasing decision before the end of October.

Thanks — Pat

--
Patricia Gomez
Head of Platform Product
Orion Analytics
Attachment: Orion_SOW_v3.pdf (application/pdf, 1 page)

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Patricia Gomez <patricia@orionanalytics.com>
Cc: salesops@orionanalytics.com
Date: 2026-10-03T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing for projected volume (12M tokens/mo)

Patricia — really appreciate the clear numbers. I can get you a first-pass offer today and will need an internal approval path for any deviation from our published rate card. Quick notes:

- We normally tier hosted API pricing with breakpoints at ~5M, 15M, and 30M tokens/month for enterprise deals.
- For a 12M steady-state ask, we'll likely propose a 12-month commit with a discounted per-token rate relative to the rate card.

I want to loop in our pricing lead and legal for an approval flow so you get a clean answer quickly. Are you flexible for a 30-min call tomorrow to walk the SOW and desired SLAs? If yes, I'll send a calendar invite.

I'll follow up internally with the proposed economics and a suggested approval matrix.

— Alex
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-03T11:31:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Orion Analytics — hosted API pricing & commit tiers (summary + ask)

Forwarding Orion's request and the SOW. Summary and recommendation below — please advise on approval path.

SUMMARY:
- Account: Orion Analytics (Deal ORN-8342)
- Ask: committed hosted API pricing for ~12M tokens/month, 12-month term. Potential to scale to 25M/mo in year 2.
- Attachment: Orion_SOW_v3.pdf (usage profile)

PROPOSED ECONOMICS (first pass):
- Published rate card: ° per-token baseline = $0.00120 / token (hosted small-model baseline)
- Option A (12M commit): commit = 12M tokens/mo; proposed per-token = $0.00092 (approx 23% off rate card)
- Option B (25M commit): per-token = $0.00078 (approx 35% off rate card)
- Option C (pilot ramp): 3-month pilot at 12M/month with a temporary 20% discount, then convert to Option A for 9 months on signed commit

KEY RISKS / QUESTIONS:
- Our published max custom discount cap is 25% without explicit pricing committee approval. Option A is at or near that cap; Option B exceeds it.
- Need legal to include a "usage floor" (75% of committed tokens) or waterfall to rate card if below threshold.
- Need to decide whether to approve an exception or present a counter with a revenue guarantee.

REQUEST:
- Can pricing ops/legal approve Option A (up to 24% discount) as a one-time exception for a 12-month commitment with a usage-floor clause? If not, recommend a counter: 20% for first 3 months pilot, then 22% for remainder if usage meets threshold.

I've attached a quick spreadsheet (internal) with model outputs; will share if useful. If you want, I can present these on the call with Patricia.

— Alex

_Attachments referenced: Orion_SOW_v3.pdf, internal_pricing_model_orion.xlsx_

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-03T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Orion Analytics — hosted API pricing & commit tiers (summary + ask)

Thanks for the summary, Alex. Quick thoughts:

- Precedent risk: approving Option B as-is (35% off) sets a high-water mark for later deals in the same segment. We should avoid that without a significant contractual protection (revenue minimums + clawback).
- Option A at ~23% is reasonable to discuss, but we should cap the exception at 22% unless we get an explicit pricing committee "stretch" approval. 22% still provides strong economics for the customer and keeps margin healthy.
- Pilot path is attractive: approve a limited-term pilot discount (20%) with a firm conversion clause and a minimum monthly revenue for the conversion to the deeper discount. That reduces credit and churn risk.

Operational asks before I sign off:
1) Add a rate-card fallback clause if monthly usage < 75% of committed tokens for 2 consecutive months.
2) Add a quarterly true-up and audit right.
3) Provide ARR runway: projected revenue over 12 months at the proposed rate.

If Alex can get the customer to accept the pilot -> convert flow, I can greenlight up to 22% immediately. Anything beyond that goes to the pricing committee (copied: finance/pricing leads).

— Karthik
VP, Pricing & Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-04T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Orion Analytics — hosted API pricing & commit tiers (summary + ask)

After reviewing the ask and the margin sensitivity, I'm approving a one-time custom pricing exception with the following conditions:

APPROVED OFFER (final):
- 12-month term, committed tokens: 12,000,000 tokens/month (ORN-8342)
- Custom per-token price: $0.00091 (24% discount off published rate card)
- Minimum usage floor: 75% of committed tokens/month. If usage drops below floor for two consecutive months, we revert to published rate card pricing and apply a one-time true-up for the underage.
- Pilot clause: first 90 days billed at the agreed rate, with a mandatory conversion call to confirm continued commitment.
- Legal: include a addendum (Custom Pricing Addendum) and DocuSign for signatures.

OPERATIONAL NOTES: 
- Require a revenue ops confirmation sheet (I've attached the pricing_approval_matrix.xlsx and a draft addendum).
- Pricing exception approved centrally for this deal only; mark as confidential. Do not share discount comps externally.
- Sales: send final offer to Patricia and copy legal and revenue ops. Route signed addendum to finance for billing setup.

I'll let Alex handle the customer communication — please use the DocuSign link when ready and add the rate-card fallback language exactly as above.

— Laura Bennett
Head of Sales, Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachment stubs: pricing_approval_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), custom_pricing_addendum_draft.docx (document)
